plan.title: Single-stage RFQ save with no vendor selected

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable the required vendor-lock configuration before creating the event.
Enable the required read-only ceiling-price configuration.
Disable the mandatory T&Cs configuration required by the case.
Configure the event as a single-stage RFQ.
Provide the required event title so the setup can proceed.
Choose the first available RFQ template, corresponding to the Buy Template action.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Open the Participants panel on the RFQ creation screen.
Open the All Vendors window without selecting any vendor.
Confirm that the All Vendors window is open before saving.
Save the empty vendor selection from within the All Vendors dialog.
Verify that the dialog closed after saving.
Verify that no application error or validation error is shown.
